course_name_original: Administración de empresas y organización de la producción

learning_outcomes.text: Applies correctly the concept of a company, its institutional and legal framework, as well as the principles of company organization and management.
Uses basic conceptual tools to understand the world of business organizations and their strategic needs.
Knows basic economic principles and analyzes the socioeconomic context of business organizations.
Describes the business system in terms of inputs, processes, products, information flows, suppliers, customers, and environment.
Applies business language to interact in interdisciplinary teams.
Understands the role of the engineering professional within business organizations.
Performs the analysis of the economic viability of investment projects.
Masters tools for managing one's own identity and activities in a digital environment (being digital).
Independently searches for and obtains information according to reliability and relevance criteria (searching).
Organizes information with appropriate tools, both online and in-person, that allow the development of their academic activities (Organizing).
Prepares information with the appropriate tools and formats for the communicative situation and does so honestly (creating).
Uses ICT to share and exchange information (sharing).

syllabus_topics: Company and its environment: economic system, market influence, competitive environment, supply and demand, microeconomics, and macroeconomics.
The company's economic-financial system: analysis of financial statements and evaluation of a company's economic situation.
Fundamentals of investment analysis, cost calculation, and company financing systems: economic analysis techniques, financial concepts, and evaluation of productive investments.
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment requires a minimum grade of 4 in each assessment component. The second sitting is independent of the first; students who do not pass the first sitting must take an exam covering the entire course content, which will be a multiple-choice test worth 100% of the grade. The use or possession of communication and data transmission devices is not allowed during tests. Fraudulent use of AI in evaluative activities is prohibited and will result in a failing grade for that activity, potentially leading to disciplinary action.
